title: Telemetry Package Manifest
description: HPC telemetry stack package registry: container images, Helm charts, git repos, pip modules.

install_mode.description: Package fetch mode. 'offline' uses Pulp local mirror; 'online' uses upstream URLs.

repo_url.description: Pulp repository base URL for offline mode. All package URLs are auto-derived from this base.

k8s_cluster_mount.description: NFS mount point on Kubernetes cluster nodes where telemetry packages are staged.
k8s_cluster_mount.errorMessage: k8s_cluster_mount is required and must be an absolute path without NUL or newline characters (e.g., '/opt/omnia/k8s_mount').

slurm_cluster_mount.description: NFS mount point on Slurm cluster nodes where LDMS configuration and data are stored.
slurm_cluster_mount.errorMessage: slurm_cluster_mount is required and must be a non-empty path (e.g., '/share_omnia').

container_registry.description: Container registry override for air-gapped clusters. Leave empty to use default registries.

helm_charts.description: Helm chart tarballs with package name, filename, and upstream URL.

pip_modules.description: Python pip packages with version constraints.
